title: Bible Lineage Timeline Family Tree
description: Application-ready JSON converted from the uploaded SVG family tree. It preserves node positions, parent-child links, visual classes, and highlighted lineages such as messianic, priestly, Israel, judge, and base lines.

source.notes: Converted from SVG path links and node text labels. Dates are not embedded in the SVG, so timeline order is based on generation depth/layout.
